root_cause.text: The `aml_sfc_probe()` function registers a NAND ECC engine via `nand_ecc_register_on_host_hw_engine()` but does not unregister it on probe failure or during device removal, causing a resource leak.

vuln_statements.stmt_text: return dev_err_probe(&pdev->dev, ret, "failed to register Aml host ecc engine.\n");
vuln_statements.explanation: This return statement is executed after a failed attempt to register the NAND ECC engine via nand_ecc_register_on_host_hw_engine(). It does not call any cleanup function (e.g., nand_ecc_unregister_on_host_hw_engine()) to unregister the engine if it was successfully registered earlier in the probe sequence, nor does it use a managed resource (devm) to automatically handle cleanup on probe failure or device removal. This omission causes a resource leak.
